title: Ledger shared definitions
description: Enumerations shared by the ledger documents. Every value is a lowercase snake_case string. A reader must refuse a value it does not know; a writer must never invent one.

order_state.title: Work order state
order_state.description: Where a work order is in its life. issued, directed, rendered and submitted are working states (the assignee owes work and a lease can expire); approved, rejected and abandoned are terminal.

medium.title: Medium
medium.description: What one work order produces. The medium decides the default lease length.

review_policy.title: Review policy
review_policy.description: How much a person reviews. A work order may override the project's policy.

story_role.title: Story role
story_role.description: A member's role in a story project.

adoption.title: Take adoption
adoption.description: Whether a take is the Moment's current cut and who decided it.

close_reason.title: Close reason
close_reason.description: Why an order stopped or was replaced. A stable code, never free text.

host_action.title: Host action
host_action.description: What story_step tells the host to do next. repin is addressed to the server, never to the host.

step_reason.title: Step reason
step_reason.description: Why a step is what it is when the action alone does not say.

hold_kind.title: Hold kind
hold_kind.description: What an order that cannot start yet is waiting on: a person's review, work still to be made, or an order missing from the listing.

reference_kind.title: Receipt reference kind
reference_kind.description: What a receipt reference points at: a take made in this ledger (it must name its take_id) or a registered asset approved outside the ledger (it must not).
